text: The smarter the city, the better it works for its citizens. This presentation by Tracey DeLeeuw, Commercial Technology Products Leader, Global Markets, Ernst & Young LLP, and Mark MacDonald, Leader, Government and Public Sector Ontario, Public Finance Management, Ernst & Young LLP, tells the story of how technology, data, connected citizens, digital literacy and our tech eco system will help Toronto become the smartest, most inclusive, thriving, healthy and happy society of the future.
The Economic Development Committee received the item for information.
